base: One completely redesigned terminal UI concept image for Repo Radar. 1536x1024 landscape straight-on edge-to-edge fixed-width C# Spectre terminal. Use the reference for terminal grid geometry and the dark palette. Add a cyan radar sweep beside the Repo Radar wordmark. Thoughtful restrained editorial layout, charcoal background, real monospace text. Small Umberto Giacobbi.biz author credit. Far fewer panels. No header boxes, pill/status buttons, boxed metrics, outlined keyboard keycaps, nested cards, boilerplate, excessive legends, or multiple borders. Keep each screen FLAT, spacious, informative. One status line pinned to bottom with thin divider. Hint keys as PLAIN TEXT. Only the main repository overview CAN show tiles. Only colour the status text and logo, no neon glow. S = scan, O = folder chooser, T = workspace tools, L = layout, F5 = fetch, F = find, A = About. English labels. Example paths, counts.
screens: First launch. Large elegant cyan-blue-white REPO RADAR wordmark. Simple question Scan E:\ for Git repositories? Enter scan · O choose folder · Esc later. Nearly empty background with no data; at most one thin dialog border.

Flat file/folder picker replacing the dashboard. Single plain directory list with chevron selected, path breadcrumb, optional file selection. No previews or panels. One horizontal rule top and bottom.

Scanning repositories. Standalone flat screen, NO cards whatsoever, NO numbers across the top, NO cached results behind. Top-left gradient logo, centered working area: Scanning repositories, E:\Projects\Studio\cli, gently moving indeterminate segmented progress with no %, '1,842 folders visited     31 repositories found'. Pinned one-line bottom 'Scanning · E:\Projects\Studio\cli'. Generous negative space.

Main dashboard. Top all counts strictly ONE inline text line '2 local   1 incoming   1 branches   1 synced   1 unverified'. No badges. Six compact repo tiles in three columns/two rows directly on the canvas, one whisper-thin gray separator per tile or simply gutter spacing. No outer frame or internal separators on the tiles. Each tile is four compact text lines: prominent acme/studio or acme/mobile remote, E:\Dev local position, Ahead 0  Behind 0, semantic condition e.g. No changes, Local edits, Incoming changes. Subtle selected chevron. Make it easy to see where work is needed in one glance.

Compact 80-column dashboard responsive reflow in exactly TWO columns of repo tiles over three rows. Each tile holds owner/name, relative folder, Ahead / Behind, plain status text. No inset badge, no outer panel or controls. Unboxed top counts. The status foot shows the full selected local path.

Flat single repository detail page. acme/studio, red Local changes and violet Incoming changes as inline text on one line. Align simple plain monospaced key/value lines for location, branch, ahead 2 behind 3, local and remote branch counts, remote URL and last check. No nested panels, cards, tables or background results.

Git fetch in progress. NO CARDS ANYWHERE even in background. No cached snapshot list. REPO RADAR gradient wordmark top left. Flat open space left aligned: 'Fetching from origin' / 'acme/studio' / 'E:\Dev\Studio' / a SINGLE segmented horizontal progress bar and 'Receiving objects 62%' / '8 of 31 repositories checked'. Pinned bottom status text 'Git fetch origin · receiving objects · acme/studio'. No visual chrome apart from two thin rules.

Tile settings. Flat two-column aligned form showing Density, Sort, Show paths, Show branch counts, Show divergence. Plain text options, highlighted active row. No card preview, no boxed toggles, no dashboards behind. Status row pins settings feedback.

Filter local changes using dashboard mode. Plain active filter title and a text status summary with no buttons. Show just two to four red local-change tiles with local path, remote, ahead/behind, compact text and lots of space. No full-width outer panel. Lower row explains Tab cycle, Esc clear.

About Repo Radar. Generous big cyan radar sweep and REPO RADAR wordmark, Umberto Giacobbi, umbertogiacobbi.biz, version 0.3.0, C# · Spectre.Console · SQLite, MIT. One centered typographic about area with lots of deliberate black space, no border and no background cards. Footer Esc return.
